test_selection_protocol.evidence: Inspected 01_cnn_training.ipynb cells1–2: optimization reads train, selection reads validation, test accessed only for schema/hashing. Threshold .5 constant; target scaler recomputed from training only. All saved epochs reproduced from validation history and losses from frozen validation inference. 02 evaluation gates on all checkpoints existing. This verifies saved code/artifact consistency, not an independently authenticated historical execution log.

historical_execution_provenance.evidence: No external immutable execution log or saved original per-event predictions. Frozen recomputation and source/checkpoint consistency support reported protocol; unrecorded manual historical actions cannot be excluded.

timing_claim_scope.evidence: Original evaluation and this audit use identical warmup/repeat/batch/synchronization rules; latency naturally varies with device load. S-minus-cutoff is correctly called same-station interval, not operational lead time. Oracle P constructs windows; no autonomous streaming P picker is implemented.

evidence.interpretation: Family labels present. Positive records are gaussian_bandlimited, negatives span four families. Lag/spectral statistics can encode family despite near-zero mean and unit variance. Family-dependent FPR and above-chance zeroed-post-P AUC support possible shortcuts, not future leakage.

causal_explanation_of_underprediction.evidence: Training magnitude imbalance, prediction compression and magnitude-dependent signed bias are measured associations. Source amplitude/distance/noise ambiguity and model/loss effects are possible; no controlled intervention here separates their causal contributions.
